question: Which version of this Apex class is on the org, and who built and last changed it?

steps.name: apex
steps.soql: SELECT Name, ApiVersion, Status, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate, LengthWithoutComments, Body FROM ApexClass WHERE Name = '{name}'

verdicts.say: No class named {name} on this org.
{name} is present. Compare the Body hash across orgs, not the dates.

traps: LastModifiedDate can read hours stale after a deploy. The Body hash is the reliable comparison.
On a deploy target, CreatedBy is the deployer and CreatedDate the deploy date. Read authorship on the org where it was built.
